evidence: Wealthnow Developer API Free tier is documented at $0/no-card/free-forever style access with 1,000 monthly credits and a hard cap rather than automatic overage. Fundamentals and Market Data are included on Free; price_snapshot costs 1 credit.

The Free fundamentals/price_snapshot documentation now explicitly defines `as_of`/`time` as the UTC time of the last trade and `quote_as_of` as the instant when the quote last changed. The API response envelope `timestamp` is separately defined as API-answer time and not market time. This materially proves the required independent trade-time vs quote-time semantics at schema level.

The Free price_snapshot exposes last trade, bid, ask, bid/ask sizes, quote_as_of, as_of/time and freshness fields while the exchange is in session. Strict B still requires a same-run RTH runtime probe proving <=60s ages and <=15s quote/trade skew; schema semantics themselves are now primary-source documented.

The dedicated Starter+ streaming route is explicitly documented as consolidated top-of-book NBBO with best bid/ask, venue IDs and quote timestamps; a separate trade-tick stream exists. This proves Wealthnow has an NBBO-capable upstream product, but does NOT prove the Free price_snapshot uses that exact consolidated feed.

The Free price_snapshot docs still do not label its bid/ask as National NBBO, SIP/UTP/CTA, or name a licensed consolidated redistributor. Its `source: market-data:v2-snapshot` label is internal and cannot establish strict G9-A.

Wealthnow Terms of Service explicitly cover the API. Automated/bot use is not categorically prohibited; the prohibition targets automation that burdens the service or bypasses rate limits/access controls. This supports sanctioned programmatic API use within documented limits.

Those Terms also state that market data and other content come from third-party providers and prohibit scraping/resale/redistribution without consent. They do not identify the live equity vendor or expressly grant the exchange/SIP non-display entitlement required by strict G9-C.

The consumer-plan comparison currently shows a 15-minute Free market-data row, while the separate Developer API documentation shows Free+ live price_snapshot and an in-RTH live example. These appear to be separate product-plan surfaces, but XRAY must not transfer entitlements between them. Only the Developer API contract is relevant to the scheduler path.

The WEALTHNOW adapter is already implemented in nasdaq-xray/strict_g9_probe.py and remains authority-gated. It may not run until A and C are proven; after that a scheduler credential and same-run RTH probe are still required.

Then configure WEALTHNOW_API_KEY and require same-run RTH B/D freshness/skew proof.
